name: research-p5c-lambda50
description: P5c's lambda=50 completion point (k=1 vs k=8), same codec/decoder and same groups as research-p5c.json. Kept as a separate config so the three already-measured lambda points are reused instead of recomputed: the runner's resume key is `experiment_id`, and `case_id` hashes `config_sha256`, so adding lambda to research-p5c.json would have invalidated and recomputed all six existing cases under an identical encoder binary (the store's recorded encmars/decmars sha256 match the current target/release binaries). lambda's {50} here is disjoint from research-p5c's {200,800,3200}, so the two configs' rows combine into exactly four distinct points per curve per image without duplicates, which is what `marsbench experiment-report --reference-group candidates1` needs for a BD-rate. Run with `--out-dir target/p5c` to append beside research-p5c's rows.
